source.title: VEM PRA REUNIÃO
source.captionProvenance: Native pt-orig automatic captions, not authored captions; retained complete with original numbering and source-relative timestamps after ffmpeg conversion.

originalAudioVerification.text: Bora pra reunião?  Reunião?  É.  Ah, não, não vou estar nessa reunião não, mas valeu, obrigado, meu irmão.  Você não vai pra reunião?  Não, é porque é reunião de planejamento de marketing, eu sou do financeiro, então não tem porquê eu estar lá.
originalAudioVerification.method: Independent unprompted large original-audio transcription by production, no expected-text forcing. Author ran no ASR/model jobs.

speakerEvidence.roles: Standing burgundy-shirt colleague invites; seated bearded navy-shirt employee declines and explains finance. Frames inspect the actual speakers; no actor-name guess is used.

adaptations: Omit the brief Reunião?/É echo before the refusal.
Keep one initial negative and reinforcing final negative; omit Ah, an extra repeated initial negative and the additional Obrigado, meu irmão after the retained informal thanks.
Keep the source confirmation question; omit the separate opening no before the answer.
Shorten marketing-planning meeting to marketing meeting; omit porque and the following explanation that the employee has no reason to attend. His department and stated objection remain unchanged.
Add Até logo only as a lesson farewell; it is not a source quotation.
teaching: English-only narration; all Portuguese is in native roles. Four complete leading translations, one technical grammar explanation and a spoken content recap.
metadata: 17 reviewed heads; token-specific glosses and broad Brazilian IPA. The rhotic and unstressed-vowel realization can vary by region; no universal all-Brazil accent claim. Every verb has written present and completed-past forms; noun/determiner forms are supplied. Histories cite relevant Priberam entries; até remains uncertain rather than asserting one speculative root.
